g.text: Two useful outputs, with different information

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #586a80

g.text: The waveform path retains a real-IF signal. The TSP1 path describes spectral power and does not carry phase.

g.text: K is the retained-bin count. At K = 129, a sparse record is 1,080 bytes and
exceeds the 952-byte dense format. TSP1 byte savings do not include Y or

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #65778a

g.text: For the 250 kpair/s fixture, the real IF center is 250 kHz and bin spacing is 1
MHz / 256. TSP1 alone cannot recover the original I/Q phase.
